mappings.note: Translation v1 describes the movement from Hazeroth to Paran. This event precedes the start of OSMAIN (which begins with God speaking to Moses in v2). There is no corresponding text in the provided OSMAIN verses.
Translation v2 ('Y Jehová habló á Moisés...') matches OSMAIN v1 ('Herren talte til Moses og sa:').
Translation v3 contains the command to send men. Matches OSMAIN v2.
Translation v4 describes Moses sending them from Paran. Matches OSMAIN v3.
Translation v5 lists Reuben's spy. Matches OSMAIN v4.
Translation v6 lists Simeon's spy. Matches OSMAIN v5.
Translation v7 lists Judah's spy (Caleb). Matches OSMAIN v6.
Translation v8 lists Issachar's spy. Matches OSMAIN v7.
Translation v9 lists Ephraim's spy (Hosea). Matches OSMAIN v8.
Translation v10 lists Benjamin's spy. Matches OSMAIN v9.
Translation v11 lists Zebulun's spy. Matches OSMAIN v10.
Translation v12 lists Joseph/Manasseh's spy. Matches OSMAIN v11.
Translation v13 lists Dan's spy. Matches OSMAIN v12.
Translation v14 lists Asher's spy. Matches OSMAIN v13.
Translation v15 lists Naphtali's spy. Matches OSMAIN v14.
Translation v16 lists Gad's spy. Matches OSMAIN v15.
Translation v17 summarizes the names and mentions Moses renaming Hosea to Joshua. Matches OSMAIN v16.
Translation v18 contains the instruction to go up through the Negev and into the hill country. Matches OSMAIN v17.
Translation v19 asks about the people (strong/weak, few/many). Matches OSMAIN v18.
Translation v20 asks about the land (good/bad) and cities (tents/fortresses). Matches OSMAIN v19.
Translation v21 asks about the soil (fertile/barren), trees, and to be brave. Matches OSMAIN v20.
Translation v22 describes the route from Zin to Rehob. Matches OSMAIN v21.
Translation v23 describes going through the Negev to Hebron and seeing Anak's descendants. Matches OSMAIN v22.
Translation v24 describes arriving at Eshcol and cutting the grape cluster. Matches OSMAIN v23.
Translation v25 names the place Eshcol after the grape cluster. Matches OSMAIN v24.
Translation v26 states they returned after forty days. Matches OSMAIN v25.
Translation v27 describes arriving at Kadesh and reporting to Moses/Aaron. Matches OSMAIN v26.
Translation v28 reports the land flows with milk and honey. Matches OSMAIN v27.
Translation v29 reports the people are strong and cities fortified. Matches OSMAIN v28.
Translation v30 lists the specific tribes in different regions (Amalekites, Hittites, etc.). Matches OSMAIN v29.
Translation v31 describes Caleb silencing the people and urging them to go up. Matches OSMAIN v30.
Translation v32 describes the other men saying they cannot go up because the people are stronger. Matches OSMAIN v31.

Translation v33 starts the report about the land devouring its inhabitants. However, OSMAIN v32 is cut off mid-sentence ('...var storvoks'). Translation v33 contains the beginning of this thought but stops before the mention of giants which appears in v34.

Translation v34 contains the rest of the sentence from OSMAIN v32 ('...storvoks' -> 'gigantes') AND the entire content of OSMAIN v33 (seeing giants/Anakim, feeling like grasshoppers). The split in OSMAIN between v32 and v33 is not present in this translation; it flows as one continuous verse.

extraContent.description: Entire verse describing the journey from Hazeroth to Paran. This content is completely missing from OSMAIN v1-v33.

The phrase 'También vimos allí gigantes... y éramos nosotros...' completes the thought started in OSMAIN v32 and includes the full text of OSMAIN v33. While this is a merge, if we strictly look at OSMAIN v32 which ends abruptly ('storvoks'), the translation provides the completion of that sentence plus the next verse's content.
